role_agent_name: Autonomous systems and drive control lead (AUTO)
abstract: Maintains dispatch interface validation records and unladen return descent durations
system_message:
You are the Autonomous systems and drive control lead (AUTO). You maintain records regarding automated dispatch telemetry interface validation, unladen return descent durations, and perception sensor durability evaluations for candidate haulage platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Perception sensor durability（LIDAR）
information_points.content:
AUTO-LIDAR-LSZ：Perception sensor maintenance tracking indicates that the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform achieves a lidar cleaning wiper service interval of 750 h during dusty environment operation.
AUTO-LIDAR-7HF：According to perception sensor durability records from dusty environment field testing, the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler exhibits a lidar cleaning wiper service interval of 250 h.
AUTO-LIDAR-LZ8：Field evaluation records for the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter establish a lidar cleaning wiper service interval of 500 h under dusty operating conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains dispatch interface validation records and unladen return descent durations（CTRL）
information_points.content:
AUTO-CTRL-R66：For the ApexDrive E-Titan Heavy Hauler, the automated dispatch telemetry interface is validated based on bidirectional messaging integration tests with the central autonomous fleet management server, and its unladen return descent duration over the standard 4.2 km crusher-to-pit-floor route is 16 min.
AUTO-CTRL-PK3：For the TerraVolt H240 Zero-Emission Platform, the automated dispatch telemetry interface is validated according to integration tests with the central autonomous fleet management server, and the unladen return descent duration along the 4.2 km return route is 16 min.
AUTO-CTRL-8UC：For the NordicCore E300 Autonomous Transporter, the automated dispatch telemetry interface is not validated during testing with the central autonomous fleet management server, while its unladen return descent duration is 16 min.
